Overview

Gondar deliveries may involve steep lanes and tight turns near the castle district. Survey photos of both ends prevent wrong truck class.

Route and timing

  • Allow buffer for weather and road works on northern legs.
  • Split load if a large villa cannot access narrow final streets—shuttle with smaller truck.
  • Keep documents for checkpoint inventory if requested.

Packing for long transit

Double-box ceramics; pad mattress corners; drain water from any appliances.

Before moving day

  • Confirm management move rules, freight lift booking, and security ID lists for truck plate and crew.
  • Declutter to reduce volume; label rooms and mark FRAGILE on electronics and glass.
  • Photograph meters and wall condition at origin; repeat at destination before furniture covers walls.
  • Check holiday traffic and end-of-month rush when picking dates.
